sources.en_wiki: Black Clover Wiki (blackclover.fandom.com): Dark Magic page (offensive: Avidya Slash, Black Blade, Dimension Slash, Avidya Wild Slash, Avidya Blunt Strike, Black Blade Shadow Strike, Dimension Slash: Equinox, Iai Slash, Death Thrust, Deep Black Blade, Black Crescent Moon; defensive: Black Hole, Black Cocoon, Dusk), Dark Cloaked Black Blade. Read through search summaries only: the wiki host is not reachable from the build machine.
sources.other_en: Secondary English pages found by search (OtakusNotes, GameRant): Black Hole absorbs spells and paralyses; Black Moon is the Mana Zone with a Black Hole; Death Thrust is used while Black Moon is active; Dimension Slash targets space itself.
sources.design: Order of acquisition decided by this mod from the arcs: see docs/magic/character_spells.md.

spells.name: Dark Cloaked Avidya Slash
spells.note: His basic slash of darkness. Mode 0 of the Dark book, so it stays in the basic book too.

spells.name: Dark Cloaked Black Blade
spells.note: Darkness coats the sword and forms a longer blade.

spells.name: Dark Cloaked Avidya Wild Slash
spells.note: Swinging wildly: a spray of Avidya Slashes.

spells.name: Dark Cloaked Black Hole
spells.note: A small black hole that swallows spells and paralyses whoever cast them.

spells.name: Dark Cloaked Dimension Slash
spells.note: A slash that cuts space itself.

spells.name: Dark Cloaked Iai Slash
spells.note: On the wiki's offensive list; no description was found. The existing page is a draw-and-dash.

spells.name: Dark Cloaked Black Moon
spells.note: A Mana Zone spell: opens with the Mana Zone gate, or near the top of the mastery bar.

spells.name: Dark Cloaked Death Thrust
spells.note: Used while Black Moon is active, so it needs the Moon cast once.

spells.name: Dark Cloaked Deep Black Blade
spells.note: On the wiki's offensive list; no description found. The effect is inferred from the name: a deeper Black Blade.

spells.name: Black Crescent Moon
spells.note: On the wiki's offensive list; no description found. The effect is inferred from the name: a wide crescent cut.

spells.name: Dark Cloaked Dimension Slash: Equinox
spells.note: Dimension Slash with the Mana Zone's reach.

notes: Not in Yami's grimoire (kept in the basic Dark book): Dark Cloaked Guard, Dark Cloaked Shadow Embrace and Black Hole Collapse are this mod's own pages and were not found in any source for Yami.
